intro: I build AI that runs on real hardware, from satellites that dodge debris on their own to cameras that sort bottles on a factory line. Then I publish the research behind it.

researchQuestion: Can two satellites from different operators agree on who moves, in minutes, with no human in the loop, and prove the agreement was fair?

interests.title: Onboard autonomy for satellites
interests.body: Collision avoidance that runs in orbit, with cooperative manoeuvre agreement over inter-satellite links.

interests.title: Edge AI on low-cost hardware
interests.body: CPU-only detection that meets real-time limits. Latency and energy, not just accuracy.

interests.title: Trustworthy and secure ML
interests.body: Label poisoning in federated learning, and securing the link between a model and the machine it drives.

interests.title: Vision for real-world monitoring
interests.body: Traffic, production lines and recycling, on live footage.
